crossRefs.note: “ ‘If a woman has a discharge of her blood many days not in the time of her period, or if she has a discharge beyond…
Then Haggai said, “If one who is unclean by reason of a dead body touch any of these, will it be unclean?” The priests…
When the days of their purification according to the law of Moses were fulfilled, they brought him up to Jerusalem, to…
(as it is written in the law of the Lord, “Every male who opens the womb shall be called holy to the Lord”),

translations.web: She shall continue in the blood of purification thirty-three days. She shall not touch any holy thing, nor come into the sanctuary, until the days of her purifying are completed.
translations.bsb: The woman shall continue in purification from her bleeding for thirty-three days. She must not touch anything sacred or go into the sanctuary until the days of her purification are complete.
translations.kjv: And she shall then continue in the blood of her purifying three and thirty days; she shall touch no hallowed thing, nor come into the sanctuary, until the days of her purifying be fulfilled.
translations.asv: And she shall continue in the blood of her purifying three and thirty days; she shall touch no hallowed thing, nor come into the sanctuary, until the days of her purifying be fulfilled.
